response.sql: WITH side_counts AS (SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(*) as side_count FROM riskandmargin r INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.dealedge), stats AS (SELECT side_count, AVG(side_count) OVER () as overall_avg FROM side_counts) SELECT SUM(side_count) as total_counts, AVG(side_count - overall_avg) as avg_excess FROM stats WHERE side_count > overall_avg
